verdict.rationale: The library is pitched for automating the web 'at scale' from custom code (gh-3) and cloud sessions can hold multiple runs, hinting at multi-task orchestration, but there is no explicit documentation of a batch/bulk API, parallel run submission, or looping over many items as a first-class feature. Missing for 10: dedicated bulk/batch endpoint or SDK pattern, concurrency limits/guidance, and hands-on evidence of running many items in one operation.
